column1: # han-fold-v1: Chinese characters between their traditional and simplified forms, for the Han
# terms of sensitive-terms-v1.tsv. Only the characters the zh rows use are listed.
#   TS: TSCharacters.txt, traditional to simplified. The fold uses these first.
#   ST: STCharacters.txt, simplified to traditional. Used to write a term in traditional.
# Each pair is the first value of its OpenCC line. Generated once from those two files;
# the generator is not kept. Format: traditional TAB simplified TAB source.
